# Overview

The cycloid is one of the most celebrated curves in classical mechanics and the calculus of variations. Discovered by Galileo and investigated by Bernoulli, Newton, Leibniz, and Huygens, it possesses two remarkable variational properties:

1. **The Brachistochrone:** The path of fastest descent under uniform gravity between two points.
2. **The Tautochrone (Isochrone):** A curve along which a particle released from rest at any point reaches the bottom in the exact same time, independent of release height.
3. **The Cycloidal Pendulum:** By suspending a flexible pendulum string between two cycloidal guides ("cheeks"), the string unwraps along the cheeks so the bob traces an exact evolute cycloid, eliminating the "circular error" of ordinary pendulums.

Below are four live, interactive in-browser simulations demonstrating these principles.

---

# Simulation 1: Generating a Cycloid — Rolling Wheel Along Underside of Axis {#sim-rolling-wheel}

A cycloid is defined geometrically as the trajectory traced out by a fixed marker point on the rim of a wheel of radius $a$ rolling without slipping along a straight line. In the Brachistochrone problem, the rail is the horizontal ceiling axis $y = 0$, and the wheel rolls along its underside ($y$ increasing downward):

- **Wheel Center:** $(x_c, y_c) = (a\theta, a)$
- **Rim Marker $P(x, y)$:** $x(\theta) = a(\theta - \sin\theta), \quad y(\theta) = a(1 - \cos\theta)$

Use the **Wheel Radius Slider ($a$)** below to interactively scale the wheel and observe how the cycloid arch dynamically stretches or compresses. You can also pause, reset, or scrub the rotation angle $\theta$ manually!

```{=html}
<div style="background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-bottom: 30px;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">

      <button id="wheel-reset-btn" style="background: #475569; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">↺ Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.9em;">

        <input type="range" id="wheel-radius-slider" min="22" max="60" step="1" value="40" style="vertical-align: middle;">
        <span id="wheel-radius-val" style="font-weight: bold; color: #38bdf8;">40 px</span>
      </label>
      <label>Angle θ: 
        <input type="range" id="wheel-theta-slider" min="0" max="1256" step="1" value="0" style="vertical-align: middle; width: 140px;">
        <span id="wheel-theta-val" style="font-weight: bold; color: #a855f7;">0.00 rad</span>
      </label>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="wheel-canvas" width="750" height="340" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; display: block;"></canvas>

  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 15px;">
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #38bdf8;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #94a3b8;">Wheel Center (x_c, y_c)</div>
      <div id="wheel-center-readout" style="font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: bold; color: #7dd3fc;">(0, 40) px</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #c084fc;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #94a3b8;">Tracing Marker P(x, y)</div>
      <div id="wheel-marker-readout" style="font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: bold; color: #d8b4fe;">(0, 0) px</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #facc15;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #94a3b8;">Launch / Slope Angle ψ</div>
      <div id="wheel-angle-readout" style="font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: bold; color: #fde047;">90.0° (Vertical)</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #4ade80;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #94a3b8;">Arch Length s(θ)</div>
      <div id="wheel-arc-readout" style="font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: bold; color: #86efac;">0.0 px</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('wheel-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let a = 40;
  let theta = 0;
  const maxTheta = 4 * Math.PI;
  let running = true;
  let animId = null;
  let lastTimestamp = 0;
  const rollSpeed = 1.6;

  const xOrigin = 50;
  const yRail = 45;

  function updateReadouts() {
    const rVal = document.getElementById('wheel-radius-val');
    const thVal = document.getElementById('wheel-theta-val');
    const thSlider = document.getElementById('wheel-theta-slider');
    if (rVal) rVal.innerText = a + ' px';
    if (thVal) thVal.innerText = theta.toFixed(2) + ' rad';
    if (thSlider) thSlider.value = Math.round((theta / maxTheta) * 1256);

    const cReadout = document.getElementById('wheel-center-readout');
    const mReadout = document.getElementById('wheel-marker-readout');
    const aReadout = document.getElementById('wheel-angle-readout');
    const sReadout = document.getElementById('wheel-arc-readout');

    if (cReadout) cReadout.innerText = `(${Math.round(a*theta)}, ${a}) px`;
    if (mReadout) mReadout.innerText = `(${Math.round(a*(theta - Math.sin(theta)))}, ${Math.round(a*(1 - Math.cos(theta)))}) px`;

    const thMod = theta % (2 * Math.PI);
    const psiDeg = ((Math.PI - thMod) / 2) * (180 / Math.PI);
    let desc = "";
    if (Math.abs(psiDeg - 90) < 2) desc = "(Vertical drop)";
    else if (Math.abs(psiDeg) < 2) desc = "(Horizontal trough)";
    else if (Math.abs(psiDeg + 90) < 2) desc = "(Vertical rise)";
    if (aReadout) aReadout.innerText = `${psiDeg.toFixed(1)}° ${desc}`;

    const sArc = 4 * a * (1 - Math.cos(thMod / 2));
    if (sReadout) sReadout.innerText = `${sArc.toFixed(1)} px`;
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Ceiling / Rail (y = 0)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, yRail);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let hx = 10; hx < canvas.width; hx += 16) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx, yRail - 14); ctx.lineTo(hx + 12, yRail); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, yRail); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, yRail); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Horizontal Rail: y = 0 (Underside track)', 20, yRail - 14);
    ctx.fillText('Origin (x=0, θ=0)', xOrigin - 25, yRail - 5);

    // Center of Mass trajectory line (y = yRail + a)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, yRail + a); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, yRail + a); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.font = '10px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Center of Mass Path: y_c = a (${a}px)`, 20, yRail + a - 5);

    // Trough depth boundary line (y = yRail + 2a)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, yRail + 2*a); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, yRail + 2*a); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c084fc';
    ctx.fillText(`Maximum Trough Depth: y_max = 2a (${2*a}px)`, 20, yRail + 2*a + 14);

    // Cusp markers (x = xOrigin + k*2*pi*a)
    for (let k = 1; k <= 2; k++) {
      const xCusp = xOrigin + k * 2 * Math.PI * a;
      if (xCusp < canvas.width) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xCusp, yRail, 4.5, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cbd5e1';
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`Cusp ${k} (${k}·2πa)`, xCusp - 30, yRail - 5);
      }
    }

    // Faint full cycloid path
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    const totalSteps = 400;
    for (let i = 0; i <= totalSteps; i++) {
      const th = (i / totalSteps) * maxTheta;
      const x = xOrigin + a * (th - Math.sin(th));
      const y = yRail + a * (1 - Math.cos(th));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Gradient fill under the active traced curve
    const currentSteps = Math.min(totalSteps, Math.floor((theta / maxTheta) * totalSteps));
    if (currentSteps > 1) {
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, yRail, 0, yRail + 2*a);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.22)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.02)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xOrigin, yRail);
      for (let i = 0; i <= currentSteps; i++) {
        const th = (i / totalSteps) * maxTheta;
        const x = xOrigin + a * (th - Math.sin(th));
        const y = yRail + a * (1 - Math.cos(th));
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      const lastTh = (currentSteps / totalSteps) * maxTheta;
      const lastX = xOrigin + a * (lastTh - Math.sin(lastTh));
      ctx.lineTo(lastX, yRail);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Glowing active traced cycloid path
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c084fc';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#a855f7';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= currentSteps; i++) {
      const th = (i / totalSteps) * maxTheta;
      const x = xOrigin + a * (th - Math.sin(th));
      const y = yRail + a * (1 - Math.cos(th));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Wheel center & Marker coordinates
    const xc = xOrigin + a * theta;
    const yc = yRail + a;
    const xp = xc - a * Math.sin(theta);
    const yp = yc - a * Math.cos(theta);

    // Instantaneous Center of Rotation (ICR) - Contact point on rail
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f43f5e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xc, yRail, 5, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fda4af';
    ctx.font = '10px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('ICR (Contact C)', xc - 36, yRail + 14);

    // Normal line connecting Contact C to Marker P
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xc, yRail); ctx.lineTo(xp, yp); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Wheel Disk Body
    const wheelGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(xc, yc, 2, xc, yc, a);
    wheelGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35)');
    wheelGrad.addColorStop(0.85, 'rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.2)');
    wheelGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55)');
    ctx.fillStyle = wheelGrad;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(xc, yc, a, 0, 2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Wheel Hub
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0284c7';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xc, yc, 5.5, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xc, yc, 2.5, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();

    // Spokes (8 spokes rotating with theta)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const spAng = theta + (i * Math.PI / 4) - Math.PI/2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xc, yc);
      ctx.lineTo(xc + a * Math.cos(spAng), yc + a * Math.sin(spAng));
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Radius arm connecting Center to Marker P
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f43f5e';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xc, yc); ctx.lineTo(xp, yp); ctx.stroke();

    // Instantaneous Velocity Vector at Marker P
    const vx = a * (1 - Math.cos(theta));
    const vy = a * Math.sin(theta);
    const vMag = Math.sqrt(vx*vx + vy*vy) || 1;
    const arrowLen = 34;
    const dirX = (vx / vMag) * arrowLen;
    const dirY = (vy / vMag) * arrowLen;

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ade80';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xp, yp); ctx.lineTo(xp + dirX, yp + dirY); ctx.stroke();

    const arrHeadLen = 7;
    const arrAng = Math.atan2(dirY, dirX);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xp + dirX, yp + dirY);
    ctx.lineTo(xp + dirX - arrHeadLen * Math.cos(arrAng - Math.PI/6), yp + dirY - arrHeadLen * Math.sin(arrAng - Math.PI/6));
    ctx.lineTo(xp + dirX - arrHeadLen * Math.cos(arrAng + Math.PI/6), yp + dirY - arrHeadLen * Math.sin(arrAng + Math.PI/6));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#86efac';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('v(t)', xp + dirX + 4, yp + dirY + 4);

    // Tracing Marker P
    ctx.shadowColor = '#e879f9';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f43f5e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xp, yp, 8, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xp - 1.5, yp - 1.5, 3, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fdf4ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('P(x,y)', xp + 10, yp + 18);
  }

  function step(ts) {
    if (!lastTimestamp) lastTimestamp = ts;
    const dt = Math.min((ts - lastTimestamp) / 1000, 0.04);
    lastTimestamp = ts;

    if (running) {
      theta += rollSpeed * dt;
      if (theta > maxTheta) {
        theta = 0;
      }
      updateReadouts();
    }

    draw();
    animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  const playBtn = document.getElementById('wheel-play-btn');
  if (playBtn) {
    playBtn.onclick = function() {
      running = !running;
      this.innerText = running ? '❚❚ Pause' : '▶ Play';
    };
  }

  const resetBtn = document.getElementById('wheel-reset-btn');
  if (resetBtn) {
    resetBtn.onclick = function() {
      theta = 0;
      updateReadouts();
      draw();
    };
  }

  const rSlider = document.getElementById('wheel-radius-slider');
  if (rSlider) {
    rSlider.oninput = function() {
      a = parseInt(this.value);
      updateReadouts();
      draw();
    };
  }

  const thSlider = document.getElementById('wheel-theta-slider');
  if (thSlider) {
    thSlider.oninput = function() {
      theta = (parseInt(this.value) / 1256) * maxTheta;
      updateReadouts();
      draw();
    };
  }

  updateReadouts();
  draw();
  animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
})();
</script>
```

# Simulation 2: The Brachistochrone Race {#sim-brachistochrone}

In 1696, Johann Bernoulli challenged mathematicians to find the shape of a wire connecting two points along which a bead will slide under gravity (without friction) in the shortest possible time.

The four competing trajectories below connect the origin $(0, 0)$ to a lower target $(x_2, y_2)$:
- <span style="color: #9333ea; font-weight: bold;">● Cycloid</span>: The true Brachistochrone ($y(\theta) = a(1 - \cos\theta), x(\theta) = a(\theta - \sin\theta)$).
- <span style="color: #f97316; font-weight: bold;">● Straight Line</span>: The shortest geometric distance ($y = \frac{y_2}{x_2} x$).
- <span style="color: #0284c7; font-weight: bold;">● Circular Arc</span>: Constant radius of curvature.
- <span style="color: #16a34a; font-weight: bold;">● Parabola</span>: Rapid initial vertical drop ($y \propto \sqrt{x}$).

```{=html}
<div style="background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-bottom: 30px;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
      <button id="brach-start-btn" style="background: #3b82f6; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">▶ Start Race</button>
      <button id="brach-reset-btn" style="background: #475569; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">↺ Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.9em;">
      <label>Speed: <input type="range" id="brach-speed-slider" min="0.2" max="2.0" step="0.1" value="1.0" style="vertical-align: middle;"></label>
      <span id="brach-speed-val">1.0x</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="brach-canvas" width="750" height="400" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; display: block;"></canvas>

  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 15px;">
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #9333ea;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #cbd5e1;">Cycloid (Brachistochrone)</div>
      <div id="time-cycloid" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #c084fc;">0.000 s</div>
      <div id="status-cycloid" style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #94a3b8;">Ready</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #0284c7;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #cbd5e1;">Circular Arc</div>
      <div id="time-circle" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #38bdf8;">0.000 s</div>
      <div id="status-circle" style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #94a3b8;">Ready</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #16a34a;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #cbd5e1;">Parabola (Square Root)</div>
      <div id="time-parabola" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #4ade80;">0.000 s</div>
      <div id="status-parabola" style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #94a3b8;">Ready</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #f97316;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #cbd5e1;">Straight Line</div>
      <div id="time-line" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #fb923c;">0.000 s</div>
      <div id="status-line" style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #94a3b8;">Ready</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('brach-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const g = 9.81;
  const xEnd = 620;
  const yEnd = 310;
  const xStart = 80;
  const yStart = 60;
  const W = xEnd - xStart;
  const H = yEnd - yStart;

  // Cycloid parameter solver for endpoint (W, H)
  // x = a*(theta - sin(theta)), y = a*(1 - cos(theta))
  // y/x = (1 - cos(theta)) / (theta - sin(theta))
  let thetaEnd = 3.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const f = (1 - Math.cos(thetaEnd)) / (thetaEnd - Math.sin(thetaEnd)) - (H / W);
    const num = Math.sin(thetaEnd) * (thetaEnd - Math.sin(thetaEnd)) - (1 - Math.cos(thetaEnd)) * (1 - Math.cos(thetaEnd));
    const den = Math.pow(thetaEnd - Math.sin(thetaEnd), 2);
    const fprime = num / den;
    thetaEnd -= f / fprime;
  }
  const aRadius = H / (1 - Math.cos(thetaEnd));

  // Build discretized paths
  const N = 400;
  function makePath(func) {
    const pts = [];
    let totLen = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      const u = i / N;
      const pt = func(u);
      if (i > 0) {
        const dx = pt.x - pts[i-1].x;
        const dy = pt.y - pts[i-1].y;
        totLen += Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
      }
      pts.push({ x: pt.x, y: pt.y, dist: totLen });
    }
    return { pts, totLen };
  }

  const cycloidPath = makePath(u => {
    const th = u * thetaEnd;
    return { x: xStart + aRadius * (th - Math.sin(th)), y: yStart + aRadius * (1 - Math.cos(th)) };
  });

  const linePath = makePath(u => ({
    x: xStart + u * W,
    y: yStart + u * H
  }));

  const parabolaPath = makePath(u => ({
    x: xStart + u * W,
    y: yStart + H * Math.sqrt(u)
  }));

  // Circular arc passing through start and end
  // Center (xc, yc), radius R
  const chord = Math.sqrt(W*W + H*H);
  const R_circ = chord * 0.85;
  const mx = (xStart + xEnd) / 2;
  const my = (yStart + yEnd) / 2;
  const dToCenter = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, R_circ*R_circ - (chord*chord)/4));
  const nx = -(yEnd - yStart) / chord;
  const ny = (xEnd - xStart) / chord;
  const circCenter = { x: mx - nx * dToCenter, y: my - ny * dToCenter };
  const ang1 = Math.atan2(yStart - circCenter.y, xStart - circCenter.x);
  const ang2 = Math.atan2(yEnd - circCenter.y, xEnd - circCenter.x);

  const circlePath = makePath(u => {
    const ang = ang1 + u * (ang2 - ang1);
    return { x: circCenter.x + R_circ * Math.cos(ang), y: circCenter.y + R_circ * Math.sin(ang) };
  });

  const runners = [
    { id: 'cycloid', name: 'Cycloid', color: '#c084fc', path: cycloidPath, s: 0, v: 0, done: false, time: 0 },
    { id: 'circle', name: 'Circular Arc', color: '#38bdf8', path: circlePath, s: 0, v: 0, done: false, time: 0 },
    { id: 'parabola', name: 'Parabola', color: '#4ade80', path: parabolaPath, s: 0, v: 0, done: false, time: 0 },
    { id: 'line', name: 'Straight Line', color: '#fb923c', path: linePath, s: 0, v: 0, done: false, time: 0 }
  ];

  let running = false;
  let animId = null;
  let speedMultiplier = 1.0;
  let lastTime = 0;

  function getPosOnPath(path, dist) {
    const pts = path.pts;
    if (dist <= 0) return pts[0];
    if (dist >= path.totLen) return pts[pts.length - 1];
    let low = 0, high = pts.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (pts[mid].dist < dist) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    const idx = Math.max(1, low);
    const p0 = pts[idx - 1];
    const p1 = pts[idx];
    const t = (dist - p0.dist) / (p1.dist - p0.dist || 1);
    return { x: p0.x + t * (p1.x - p0.x), y: p0.y + t * (p1.y - p0.y) };
  }

  function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
    for (let x = 50; x < canvas.width; x += 50) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 50; y < canvas.height; y += 50) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw tracks with glow and prominent labels
    runners.forEach(r => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.shadowColor = r.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      r.path.pts.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    });

    // On-canvas track labels
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c084fc';
    const pCyc = getPosOnPath(cycloidPath, cycloidPath.totLen * 0.45);
    ctx.fillText('🟣 Cycloid (Fastest)', pCyc.x - 30, pCyc.y + 22);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    const pCirc = getPosOnPath(circlePath, circlePath.totLen * 0.35);
    ctx.fillText('🔵 Circular Arc', pCirc.x - 20, pCirc.y + 18);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
    const pPara = getPosOnPath(parabolaPath, parabolaPath.totLen * 0.55);
    ctx.fillText('🟢 Parabola', pPara.x - 10, pPara.y - 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fb923c';
    const pLine = getPosOnPath(linePath, linePath.totLen * 0.7);
    ctx.fillText('🟠 Straight Line', pLine.x - 10, pLine.y - 12);

    // Start Marker
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xStart, yStart, 6, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Start (0,0)', xStart - 32, yStart - 14);

    // Finish Line Banner & Marker
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xEnd, yEnd - 25);
    ctx.lineTo(xEnd, yEnd + 25);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xEnd, yEnd, 7, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.fillText('🏁 Finish (x₂, y₂)', xEnd - 45, yEnd + 38);

    // Draw Beads with Glow & Direction
    runners.forEach(r => {
      const pos = getPosOnPath(r.path, r.s);
      ctx.shadowColor = r.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 8.5, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // Inner shine
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pos.x - 2, pos.y - 2, 2.5, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function step(timestamp) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
    const realDt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = timestamp;

    const dt = realDt * speedMultiplier;
    let allDone = true;

    runners.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.done) {
        allDone = false;
        r.time += dt;
        const pos = getPosOnPath(r.path, r.s);
        const dropY = Math.max(0.001, (pos.y - yStart) / 120); // Normalized scale
        const vPhys = Math.sqrt(2 * g * dropY);
        const pxPerSec = vPhys * 180;
        r.s += pxPerSec * dt;

        document.getElementById('time-' + r.id).innerText = r.time.toFixed(3) + ' s';
        document.getElementById('status-' + r.id).innerText = 'Racing...';

        if (r.s >= r.path.totLen) {
          r.s = r.path.totLen;
          r.done = true;
          document.getElementById('status-' + r.id).innerText = 'Finished 🏁';
          document.getElementById('status-' + r.id).style.color = '#38bdf8';
        }
      }
    });

    render();

    if (allDone) {
      running = false;
      document.getElementById('brach-start-btn').innerText = '▶ Restart';
    } else if (running) {
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
  }

  function resetRace() {
    running = false;
    if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    lastTime = 0;
    runners.forEach(r => {
      r.s = 0;
      r.v = 0;
      r.done = false;
      r.time = 0;
      document.getElementById('time-' + r.id).innerText = '0.000 s';
      document.getElementById('status-' + r.id).innerText = 'Ready';
      document.getElementById('status-' + r.id).style.color = '#94a3b8';
    });
    document.getElementById('brach-start-btn').innerText = '▶ Start Race';
    render();
  }

  document.getElementById('brach-start-btn').onclick = function() {
    if (running) return;
    if (runners.every(r => r.done)) resetRace();
    running = true;
    lastTime = 0;
    this.innerText = 'Racing...';
    animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  document.getElementById('brach-reset-btn').onclick = resetRace;

  const slider = document.getElementById('brach-speed-slider');
  slider.oninput = function() {
    speedMultiplier = parseFloat(this.value);
    document.getElementById('brach-speed-val').innerText = speedMultiplier.toFixed(1) + 'x';
  };

  render();
})();
</script>
```

# Simulation 3: The Tautochrone (Isochrone) Property {#sim-tautochrone}

Huygens discovered in 1659 that an inverted cycloid is **tautochronous**: a frictionless particle sliding down a cycloidal track to the lowest point takes the *exact same time* regardless of where on the arch it is released!

The equation of motion along the arc length $s$ (measured from the trough) is pure simple harmonic motion:
$$ \ddot{s} + \left(\frac{g}{4a}\right) s = 0 $$
All beads reach the trough $s = 0$ at the identical quarter-period mark:
$$ t_{\text{trough}} = \pi \sqrt{\frac{a}{g}} $$

In the simulation below, four beads are placed at widely disparate initial release heights along the cycloid. Press **"Release All Beads"** and watch them converge at the bottom in perfect synchronization!

```{=html}
<div style="background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-bottom: 30px;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
      <button id="tauto-start-btn" style="background: #10b981; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">▶ Release All Beads</button>
      <button id="tauto-reset-btn" style="background: #475569; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">↺ Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.9em;">
      <span id="tauto-timer-display" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #34d399;">Timer: 0.000 s</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="tauto-canvas" width="750" height="380" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; display: block;"></canvas>

  <div id="tauto-banner" style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #1e293b; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; color: #94a3b8; border: 1px dashed #334155;">
    Press "Release All Beads" to observe simultaneous arrival at the trough.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('tauto-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const g = 9.81;
  const aRadius = 55;
  const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
  const topY = 40;
  const omega0 = Math.sqrt(g / (4 * (aRadius / 100))); // Scaled frequency
  const T_quarter = (Math.PI / (2 * omega0));

  // Cycloid arch: theta in [0, 2*pi]
  // x(theta) = centerX + aRadius*(theta - pi - sin(theta - pi))
  // y(theta) = topY + aRadius*(1 - cos(theta))
  const N = 400;
  const archPts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const th = (i / N) * 2 * Math.PI;
    const x = centerX + aRadius * ((th - Math.PI) + Math.sin(th));
    const y = topY + aRadius * (1 - Math.cos(th));
    archPts.push({ theta: th, x, y });
  }

  // Arc length from trough: s(theta) = 4*a*cos(theta/2)
  function thetaFromArc(s) {
    const val = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, s / (4 * aRadius)));
    return 2 * Math.acos(val);
  }

  function getCoords(th) {
    const x = centerX + aRadius * ((th - Math.PI) + Math.sin(th));
    const y = topY + aRadius * (1 - Math.cos(th));
    return { x, y };
  }

  const beads = [
    { name: "Cyan", color: "#38bdf8", s0: 3.6 * aRadius, s: 3.6 * aRadius },
    { name: "Yellow", color: "#facc15", s0: 2.7 * aRadius, s: 2.7 * aRadius },
    { name: "Purple", color: "#c084fc", s0: 1.8 * aRadius, s: 1.8 * aRadius },
    { name: "Pink", color: "#f472b6", s0: 0.9 * aRadius, s: 0.9 * aRadius }
  ];

  let simTime = 0;
  let running = false;
  let animId = null;
  let lastTimestamp = 0;
  let reachedTrough = false;

  function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Floor & trough marker
    const trough = getCoords(Math.PI);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(trough.x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(trough.x, canvas.height);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Draw Cycloid Track
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    archPts.forEach((p, i) => {
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    });
    ctx.stroke();

    // Trough indicator dot
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(trough.x, trough.y + 4, 6, 0, 2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Trough (Lowest Point)', trough.x - 60, trough.y + 24);

    // Draw Beads
    beads.forEach(b => {
      const th = thetaFromArc(b.s);
      const pos = getCoords(th);

      ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 9, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // Center shine
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pos.x - 2, pos.y - 2, 2.5, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function step(timestamp) {
    if (!lastTimestamp) lastTimestamp = timestamp;
    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000, 0.04);
    lastTimestamp = timestamp;

    simTime += dt;
    document.getElementById('tauto-timer-display').innerText = 'Timer: ' + simTime.toFixed(3) + ' s';

    // Harmonic motion: s(t) = s0 * cos(omega0 * t)
    beads.forEach(b => {
      b.s = b.s0 * Math.cos(omega0 * simTime);
    });

    if (!reachedTrough && simTime >= T_quarter) {
      reachedTrough = true;
      const banner = document.getElementById('tauto-banner');
      banner.style.background = '#065f46';
      banner.style.color = '#34d399';
      banner.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
      banner.innerHTML = `⭐ <b>PERFECT SYNCHRONIZATION DETECTED!</b> All 4 beads reached the trough simultaneously at <i>t</i> = ${simTime.toFixed(3)} s (Theoretical: ${T_quarter.toFixed(3)} s)!`;
    }

    render();

    if (running) {
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    running = false;
    if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    simTime = 0;
    lastTimestamp = 0;
    reachedTrough = false;
    beads.forEach(b => { b.s = b.s0; });
    document.getElementById('tauto-timer-display').innerText = 'Timer: 0.000 s';
    const banner = document.getElementById('tauto-banner');
    banner.style.background = '#1e293b';
    banner.style.color = '#94a3b8';
    banner.style.borderColor = '#334155';
    banner.innerHTML = 'Press "Release All Beads" to observe simultaneous arrival at the trough.';
    document.getElementById('tauto-start-btn').innerText = '▶ Release All Beads';
    render();
  }

  document.getElementById('tauto-start-btn').onclick = function() {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    lastTimestamp = 0;
    this.innerText = 'Oscillating...';
    animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  document.getElementById('tauto-reset-btn').onclick = reset;

  render();
})();
</script>
```

# Simulation 4: Huygens' Isochronous Cycloidal Pendulum {#sim-huygens}

In a standard circular pendulum, the period increases with amplitude:
$$ T \approx 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{L}{g}}\left(1 + \frac{1}{16}\theta_0^2 + \frac{11}{3072}\theta_0^4 + \dots\right) $$
This **circular error** caused grandfather clocks to lose time whenever the drive spring wound down and the swing amplitude decreased.

Christiaan Huygens eliminated this error in 1673 by flanking the suspension string with two curved metal guides shaped like cycloids (**cycloidal cheeks**). As the pendulum swings wide, the flexible string wraps against the cheek, shortening the effective radius of curvature and accelerating the bob just enough so that the trajectory of the bob is an exact evolute cycloid!

The period of Huygens' cycloidal clock is strictly invariant across all amplitudes:
$$ T_{\text{cycloid}} = 4\pi\sqrt{\frac{a}{g}} $$

### Live Side-by-Side Comparison

Observe the simulation below:
- **Left:** Huygens' Cycloidal Pendulum with cycloidal cheeks (String wraps against cheeks).
- **Right:** Standard Circular Pendulum of the same nominal length $L = 4a$.
- Drag the **Release Amplitude Slider** up to $75^\circ$ to see the standard pendulum suffer massive circular error lag, while Huygens' clock keeps perfect time!

```{=html}
<div style="background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-bottom: 30px;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
      <button id="huygens-toggle-btn" style="background: #6366f1; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">❚❚ Pause</button>
      <button id="huygens-reset-btn" style="background: #475569; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s;">↺ Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 15px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.9em;">
      <label>Release Amplitude θ₀: 
        <input type="range" id="huygens-amp-slider" min="15" max="80" step="5" value="65" style="vertical-align: middle;">
      </label>
      <span id="huygens-amp-val" style="font-weight: bold; color: #a5b4fc;">65°</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="huygens-canvas" width="750" height="420" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; display: block;"></canvas>

  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 15px; margin-top: 15px;">
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #818cf8;">
      <div style="font-weight: bold; color: #c7d2fe;">Huygens' Cycloidal Pendulum</div>
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 4px;">Constrained by cheeks • <b>Strictly Isochronous</b></div>
      <div style="font-size: 1.1em; color: #34d399; margin-top: 6px;">Exact Period: T = 1.795 s</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background: #1e293b; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid #f43f5e;">
      <div style="font-weight: bold; color: #fecdd3;">Ordinary Circular Pendulum</div>
      <div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 4px;">Unconstrained string • <b>Suffers Circular Error</b></div>
      <div id="simple-period-readout" style="font-size: 1.1em; color: #fb7185; margin-top: 6px;">Period: T ≈ 1.942 s (+8.2% slow)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('huygens-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const g = 9.81;
  const aRadius = 38; // Radius of generating wheel
  const L = 4 * aRadius; // Total string length = 152 px

  const pivot1 = { x: canvas.width * 0.28, y: 50 };
  const pivot2 = { x: canvas.width * 0.74, y: 50 };

  let ampDeg = 65;
  let ampRad = ampDeg * Math.PI / 180;
  let running = true;
  let animId = null;
  let simTime = 0;
  let lastTs = 0;

  // Simple pendulum numerical state
  let theta_simple = ampRad;
  let omega_simple = 0.0;

  // Cycloidal pendulum natural frequency
  // s(t) = s0 * cos(omega_c * t) where omega_c = sqrt(g / (4a))
  const omega_c = Math.sqrt(g / (4 * (aRadius / 100)));
  const T_cycloid = 2 * Math.PI / omega_c;

  // Generate cycloidal cheek paths (evolute of bob trajectory)
  // Left cheek: theta in [0, pi]
  // Right cheek: theta in [0, pi]
  const cheekN = 80;
  const leftCheek = [];
  const rightCheek = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= cheekN; i++) {
    const th = (i / cheekN) * Math.PI;
    // Left cheek
    const xl = pivot1.x - aRadius * (th - Math.sin(th));
    const yl = pivot1.y + aRadius * (1 - Math.cos(th));
    leftCheek.push({ x: xl, y: yl });

    // Right cheek
    const xr = pivot1.x + aRadius * (th - Math.sin(th));
    const yr = pivot1.y + aRadius * (1 - Math.cos(th));
    rightCheek.push({ x: xr, y: yr });
  }

  function updateSimplePendulumReadout() {
    const errorFactor = 1 + (1/16) * Math.pow(ampRad, 2) + (11/3072) * Math.pow(ampRad, 4);
    const T_simple = T_cycloid * errorFactor;
    const pct = ((errorFactor - 1) * 100).toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('simple-period-readout').innerText = `Period: T ≈ ${T_simple.toFixed(3)} s (+${pct}% slow)`;
  }
  updateSimplePendulumReadout();

  function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Divider line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2, 20);
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 20);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. LEFT: Huygens' Cycloidal Pendulum
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // Suspension Ceiling
    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.fillRect(pivot1.x - 110, pivot1.y - 12, 220, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText("Huygens' Cycloidal Cheeks", pivot1.x - 75, pivot1.y - 18);

    // Draw Cycloidal Cheeks
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#818cf8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    leftCheek.forEach((p, i) => { if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y); });
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    rightCheek.forEach((p, i) => { if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y); });
    ctx.stroke();

    // Cycloid bob kinematics: s(t) = s0 * cos(omega_c * t)
    const s0 = 4 * aRadius * Math.sin(ampRad / 2);
    const sCurrent = s0 * Math.cos(omega_c * simTime);
    // Corresponding angle: s = 4a*sin(phi/2)
    const phi_c = 2 * Math.asin(Math.max(-0.999, Math.min(0.999, sCurrent / (4 * aRadius))));

    // Bob coordinates: x = a*(phi + sin(phi)), y = a*(1 - cos(phi))
    const bob1X = pivot1.x + aRadius * (phi_c + Math.sin(phi_c));
    const bob1Y = pivot1.y + aRadius * (3 - Math.cos(phi_c)); // Adjusted for suspension

    // String drawing (tangent to cheek or straight)
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pivot1.x, pivot1.y);
    // Draw approximation of wrapped string
    if (Math.abs(phi_c) > 0.1) {
      const cheek = phi_c > 0 ? rightCheek : leftCheek;
      const wrapIdx = Math.min(cheek.length - 1, Math.floor((Math.abs(phi_c) / Math.PI) * cheek.length * 0.7));
      for (let i = 0; i <= wrapIdx; i++) {
        ctx.lineTo(cheek[i].x, cheek[i].y);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(bob1X, bob1Y);
    } else {
      ctx.lineTo(bob1X, bob1Y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Cycloidal Bob
    ctx.shadowColor = '#818cf8';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#818cf8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bob1X, bob1Y, 12, 0, 2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. RIGHT: Simple Circular Pendulum
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // Ceiling
    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.fillRect(pivot2.x - 70, pivot2.y - 12, 140, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.fillText("Standard Pivot", pivot2.x - 45, pivot2.y - 18);

    const bob2X = pivot2.x + L * 1.35 * Math.sin(theta_simple);
    const bob2Y = pivot2.y + L * 1.35 * Math.cos(theta_simple);

    // Rod
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pivot2.x, pivot2.y);
    ctx.lineTo(bob2X, bob2Y);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Circular Bob
    ctx.shadowColor = '#f43f5e';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f43f5e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bob2X, bob2Y, 12, 0, 2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Center pivot dots
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pivot1.x, pivot1.y, 4, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pivot2.x, pivot2.y, 4, 0, 2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
  }

  function step(ts) {
    if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
    const dt = Math.min((ts - lastTs) / 1000, 0.04);
    lastTs = ts;

    simTime += dt;

    // RK4 integration for non-linear simple pendulum
    const L_phys = (L * 1.35) / 120; // scale
    function f_alpha(th) { return -(g / L_phys) * Math.sin(th); }
    
    // Sub-stepping for stability
    const subSteps = 4;
    const subDt = dt / subSteps;
    for (let stepIdx = 0; stepIdx < subSteps; stepIdx++) {
      const k1_v = f_alpha(theta_simple);
      const k1_x = omega_simple;

      const k2_v = f_alpha(theta_simple + 0.5 * subDt * k1_x);
      const k2_x = omega_simple + 0.5 * subDt * k1_v;

      const k3_v = f_alpha(theta_simple + 0.5 * subDt * k2_x);
      const k3_x = omega_simple + 0.5 * subDt * k2_v;

      const k4_v = f_alpha(theta_simple + subDt * k3_x);
      const k4_x = omega_simple + subDt * k3_v;

      omega_simple += (subDt / 6) * (k1_v + 2*k2_v + 2*k3_v + k4_v);
      theta_simple += (subDt / 6) * (k1_x + 2*k2_x + 2*k3_x + k4_x);
    }

    render();

    if (running) {
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    simTime = 0;
    lastTs = 0;
    theta_simple = ampRad;
    omega_simple = 0.0;
    render();
  }

  document.getElementById('huygens-toggle-btn').onclick = function() {
    running = !running;
    this.innerText = running ? '❚❚ Pause' : '▶ Resume';
    if (running) {
      lastTs = 0;
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
  };

  document.getElementById('huygens-reset-btn').onclick = function() {
    reset();
  };

  const slider = document.getElementById('huygens-amp-slider');
  slider.oninput = function() {
    ampDeg = parseInt(this.value);
    ampRad = ampDeg * Math.PI / 180;
    document.getElementById('huygens-amp-val').innerText = ampDeg + '°';
    updateSimplePendulumReadout();
    reset();
  };

  render();
  animId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
})();
</script>
```
